Andhra Pradesh Issues Statewide COVID Alert After 2 Deaths | WION
WION
10500000 subscribers

14 Jul 2026
Andhra Pradesh is back on alert. The state has reported 8 COVID cases, and authorities say all patients are currently asymptomatic. But the concern is rising after 2 people who tested positive died within 10 days. In response, health officials have ramped up precautionary measures across districts — more testing, stricter monitoring in hospitals, and renewed advisories for masks and hygiene.
